scope: Corporate-action field knowledge only; no canonical freeze or research eligibility promotion

evidence_required: verified timezone valid for the historical interval
binding to the selected field and document version
rules.proposal: Use verified publication instant for the relevant field; preserve raw timestamp and actual observed_at.

evidence_required: verified publication date, not document signature/ex/record date
binding to selected field and document version
frozen trading calendar and decision schedule
rules.proposal: Keep precision DATE. Derive a conservative knowledge bound at the start of the next local calendar day; consume only at an eligible decision in the following trading session or later. Do not fabricate source publication time or use same-day 17:00.

evidence_required: provider evidence or historical archive proving selected content was public by the update timestamp
verified source timezone for historical interval
resolved revision lineage and no future inheritance
rules.proposal: An update may supply a conservative known-by bound, not an initial publication timestamp. Store bound, basis, evidence and policy version separately; do not put UPDATE into source_published_at.
rules.current_evidence_status: Timezone and historical content/version binding remain unverified in bounded research.

rules.proposal: Retain actual first-observed evidence and historical PIT PARTIAL. No inference from nearby dates, search-engine metadata, HTTP Date, signature date or website language.
Keep ex_date and record_date as event/entitlement dates. They do not establish publication or knowledge time. Retain first-observed and PIT PARTIAL.
Use actual observed_at as an observation bound; retain historical PIT PARTIAL. Observing in 2026 does not prove historical availability in 2019-2025.
Evaluate each field/version using its own public evidence. A final corrected value cannot be inherited into a historical original. Unresolved revision graphs remain in review.

event_aggregation_proposal: For the approved effective field versions, take the latest required-field knowledge bound. Missing or unresolved required evidence prevents PIT completion; DATA verification stays independent.
forbidden_shortcuts: approve UTC+7 alone and promote all VSDC records
use announcement_date field name as proof of publication semantics
ex_date or record_date as publication proxy
activation_gate: Explicit owner approval of identified rules, scope, evidence standard and policy version; separate STAGE 3B with tests and versioned derived artifacts.
